profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 79 (Skybox missing-address campaign): applied 800 East Devon Avenue, Elk Grove Village, sourced from a data center industry aggregator directorys general area listing naming this exact facility. Added 30 MW capacity and 10 acre campus size from the operators own refetched dedicated page, plus a Prologis joint venture ownership note per the operators own site.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Skybox Datacenters facility, Skybox Chicago I, is in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, near Chicago. The operators own dedicated page for this facility, refetched directly this session, gives 30 MW of capacity, 190,000 square feet, and a 10 acre campus, with power density options ranging from 275 to 340 watts per square foot across different redundancy tiers, and lists the facility as available now. A data center industry aggregator directorys general area listing independently names this exact facility, Skybox Chicago I under operator Skybox Datacenters, at 800 East Devon Avenue, Elk Grove Village, IL 60007, which this session applies as this rows address. This session refetched the operators own dedicated Chicago area location page directly and found it states, in its own words, ownership as Skybox Powered by Prologis, describing a joint venture. Prologis is a large, publicly traded industrial and logistics real estate company. No second, independent source describing this relationship was found this session, though the statement comes directly from the operators own site, the highest tier source under this projects source hierarchy. The company also confirms Houston, Santa Clara, California, and Northern Virginia among its completed projects, with projects underway in Austin, Dallas, and Wichita Falls, Texas, developing high density hyperscale data centers under its PowerCampus product with private onsite substations. No founding date or headquarters address for the company itself were located in available sourcing this session.

reading.body:
Skybox Chicago I in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, is operated by Skybox, but no IT capacity in megawatts has been published for this facility.

Without a published capacity figure, the facility cannot be sized against other data centers in this collection, or judged for whether it could plausibly host AI training infrastructure, which typically requires tens of megawatts and up. What is on record is the facility's location and operator, not its scale.

Skybox Chicago I holds 1 published certification: LEED (a specific compliance or security standard). Together these qualify the facility for regulated workloads spanning security auditing, payments, and healthcare data, though which specific tenants rely on which certification is not disclosed.

Illinois has 13 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 6 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 236 MW.
